name: Direct3D-S2
paper_title: Direct3D-S2: Gigascale 3D Generation Made Easy with Spatial Sparse Attention
license_interpretation: MIT is a permissive license, so the code and weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products; the only obligation is to keep the copyright and license notice with copies. LibreYOLO's adapter is MIT; the flow transformers, SDF VAE decoders, refiners and spatial sparse attention it adapts from Direct3D-S2 keep MIT, with the attention following native-sparse-attention-triton (Apache-2.0) and the transformer modules TRELLIS's (MIT), noted in libreyolo/models/gen/direct3d_s2/NOTICE. Upstream's hole filling and remeshing, which need GPL-licensed pymeshfix and python-igraph, are not used. The wushuang98/Direct3D-S2 v1.1 weights (MIT) are redistributed unchanged as LibreYOLO/LibreDirect3DS2v11; the BiRefNet weights (MIT) come from LibreYOLO/LibreTRELLISl and the DINOv2 encoder, facebook/dinov2-with-registers-large (Apache-2.0), from Meta. All are pinned and none is gated.
